packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates in one PR, merged by themselves once CI is green
Major updates in their own PRs, merged by themselves once CI is green

New CI Python minors (3.15+) wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: h5py, pyclipper and pyyaml (pulled in by python-doctr) have no 3.15 wheels yet, so pip builds them from source and the install fails. Approve there once they ship wheels for the new version.
